subject: RFI: Governance Annex + Eval Roadmap — Orion Capital
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@orioncapital.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Orion Capital Security Team <security@orioncapital.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: RFI: Governance Annex + Eval Roadmap — initial ask

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for taking Orion Capital's RFI. Attached is our governance questionnaire (we've consolidated vendor questions into a single annex). We're primarily focused on how you map to NIST AI RMF, your EU AI Act posture for high-risk deployment, and the specifics of your evaluation/regression approach for model updates.

Top asks for this phase:
- A mapping table (control -> Redwood artifact/evidence) for NIST AI RMF categories.
- A short statement on how Redwood assesses whether a product offering would classify as "high-risk" under the EU AI Act and default mitigations.
- An eval/regression plan: sampling strategy, metrics, thresholds for rollback, and cadence for re-eval.
- Any SOC 2 / third-party audit artifacts you can share (redacted is fine).

We need the Annex + eval plan to include enough detail for our Security and Procurement teams to accept technical responses before legal asks for contract redlines. Can you confirm timelines?

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Chen
VP, Risk & Compliance — Orion Capital

Attachment: orion_rfi_initial.pdf (vendor questionnaire)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@orioncapital.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RFI: Governance Annex + Eval Roadmap — initial ask

Laura —

Appreciate the clear asks. We can deliver a Governance Annex and a companion Eval Sampling Plan with concrete artifacts by EOD next Wednesday (2026-12-08). Outline we'll provide:

1) NIST AI RMF mapping (controls -> product docs, test artifacts, SOC2 sections where applicable).
2) EU AI Act posture: decision record for high-risk classification, default mitigations (data governance, human oversight, logging, HSM/KMS, on-prem/private deployment options).
3) Eval + Regression plan: sampling approach, core metrics (factuality, hallucination rate, safety taxonomy pass/fail), regression guardrails, canary rollout procedure, rollback thresholds and SLA impact.
4) Evidence bundle: redacted SOC2 summary, retention/retention schedules, example audit logs (stubs), and a traceability matrix.

I am attaching a draft "Governance Annex (v0.1)" with high-level mapping and the start of the sampling plan. Priyom will add technical specifics on test harness and metric thresholds. Neha will add compliance notes re: EU Act.

Would you like a 30-minute sync to walk through the Annex before we finalize? If so, propose times and I'll coordinate.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
mobile: +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: redwood_governance_annex_v1.pdf (draft)

From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@orioncapital.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Orion Capital Security Team <security@orioncapital.com>, Kyle Morris <kyle.morris@orioncapital.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RFI: Governance Annex + Eval Roadmap — clarifications

Rishi —

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the draft. A couple of clarifying items from Security / Procurement before a sync:

- Data residency: we need explicit options for EU-only deployments and confirmation of controls in those regions (backup/replication, key separation).
- Logged data: retention windows and redaction capabilities for logs that may contain PII.
- Evaluation samples: can you show a sample prompt set (10-20 examples) used for the regression harness and explain how you seed adversarial edge-cases?

Procurement (cc'd Kyle) is also asking if we can get the Annex in a format that maps to our questionnaire column names (we'll share a template if needed).

Prefer a sync on Friday 12/04 9-10am PT or Monday 12/07 11am-12pm PT.

Laura

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@orioncapital.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 14:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RFI: Governance Annex + Eval Roadmap — clarifications

Laura, Kyle —

Thanks — confirmed for Monday 12/07 11:00am PT. Agenda: quick walkthrough of the Annex + sampling artifacts, then open Qs. We'll upload a copy of the Annex mapped to your column names ahead of the call.

Quick answers to your clarifying questions:

- Data residency: Redwood supports region-specific deployments via our Private offering (VPC and on-prem). For EU-only deployment we provide separate compute clusters, region-scoped key management (customer-managed KMS), and explicit S3/object store controls; backups are region-restricted by default in that configuration. We'll include the technical config snippets in the Annex.

- Logged data: retention is configurable per-customer; our defaults: 90 days for request/response traces, 400 days for compacted audit logs used for compliance. We support query-time redaction and automated PII masking in logs prior to storage if requested.

- Eval samples / adversarial seeding: attached is an excerpt of our prompt suite (20 samples) and a short note on adversarial augmentation (prompt permutations, label-noise injection, stress tests on long context). The sampling plan includes stratified sampling by route, user-agent, and prompt length to maintain representative coverage.

Attached: eval_sampling_plan_v1.xlsx (excerpt). Priyom will follow with details on metric thresholds and the continuous regression harness.

Regards,
Rishi

Attachment: eval_sampling_plan_v1.xlsx (excerpt)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@orioncapital.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RFI: Governance Annex + Eval Roadmap — technical addendum

Laura —

Following our call, a short technical addendum with concrete thresholds and the NIST/EU mapping summary:

1) NIST AI RMF mapping: shipped as a CSV (attached: nist_eu_mapping_v1.csv) that links each RMF subcategory to Redwood artifacts. Example: PR.DS-1 -> Data minimization policy (doc link), PR.DS-2 -> Customer-configurable retention + PII redaction (audit artifact), RS.MI-3 -> Regression harness sampling logs.

2) EU AI Act posture: we use a decision matrix (included) — features that enable automated decision-making with legal/financial effect trigger a high-risk workflow. For high-risk classification we apply mandatory controls: documented human oversight, explicit explanations for outputs (where possible), locked-down deployment (Dedicated/Private), and a regimented pre-release eval with higher sampling and stricter rollback thresholds.

3) Regression harness & thresholds:
- Metrics: Factuality F1, Hallucination Rate (explicit hallucinations per 100 responses), Safety taxonomy pass rate, Latency percentiles (p95 target).
- Canary thresholds: degrade >5pp on Safety pass rate OR hallucination increase >3x baseline -> automatic halt.
- Daily automated smoke + weekly statistical sampling + ad-hoc targeted stress tests for major model merges.

4) Evidence & audit: We can provide a redacted SOC2 report summary and example ingestion/audit logs. For procurement, we will prepare a short appendix that maps our artifact names to your questionnaire columns.

Next steps: we'll drop the CSVs and the mapped Annex to your shared folder by EOD today and prepare a short one-page decision memo for legal.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Applied ML Engineer — Redwood Inference

Attachment: nist_eu_mapping_v1.csv (control -> artifact mapping)

From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@orioncapital.com>

Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 16:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RFI: Governance Annex + Eval Roadmap — next steps

Rishi / Priyom,

Appreciate the fast, detailed responses and the mapping files. The Security team is satisfied with the technical mitigations and the decision matrix; Procurement asked that we push this to Legal for contract language on data residency and audit access. Kyle will share a redlines request shortly.

Please mark the Governance Annex as "final" and include the one-page decision memo mentioned by Priyom. Also include the redacted SOC2 summary and an export of the mapped questionnaire (column names matched). Once Legal confirms, we'll schedule a procurement review on 12/15.

Thanks again — this is exactly the level of detail we needed.

Laura
VP, Risk & Compliance — Orion Capital
